entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person wearing a flat brown hat, a light blue long-sleeved shirt, gray-green bib overalls, brown gloves, and dark boots.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: A goose with a white body, a long, slender, curved neck, and an orange beak and feet.

entities.name: group of white marked bags
entities.identification: Two flattened, bulging white bags to the image-left of the wooden door, with blue ends and red graphic markings.

entities.name: pond surface
entities.identification: The light blue water surface inside the pond edge.

entities.name: pond-edge stones
entities.identification: Light gray irregular stones of different sizes arranged along the pond edge.

entities.name: aquatic plants
entities.identification: Clusters of pale green, long, narrow leaves extending from the water-facing side of the pond edge.

entities.name: gray-green lawn
entities.identification: Large areas of gray-green ground on both sides of the path, with outlines of short grass along the edges.

entities.name: light gray path
entities.identification: A light gray path crossing the lawn, with its right section curving toward the image-bottom-right and a branch path connected on the left.

entities.name: wooden bench
entities.identification: A brown wooden bench with a backrest, seat boards, armrests, and legs.

entities.name: blue square object
entities.identification: A thin, approximately square object at the image-left end of the bench seat, with a dark blue center and light blue border.

entities.name: reddish-brown wall
entities.identification: A reddish-brown wall surface behind the wooden door and white bags, partially visible along the top edge of the image.

entities.name: open wooden door
entities.identification: An open light brown plank door in the image-upper-right, with vertical planks, horizontal connecting boards, and a partially visible dark component.

entities.name: orange hose
entities.identification: A long, thin orange hose extending along the base of the wall, with a curved segment exposed beside the wooden door.

entities.name: long-handled shovel beside the door
entities.identification: A gray shovel blade exposed beside the image-left edge of the wooden door, with part of the shaft extending upward.

entities.name: light gray stepping stone
entities.identification: Light gray, approximately rectangular stone slabs laid separately to the right of the wooden door.

entities.name: light gray handheld device
entities.identification: A light gray rectangular device carried by Person A, with red and dark bars on its surface.

entities.name: dark-handled, broad, flat tool
entities.identification: A tool beside the path, with a thin dark handle connected to the lower end of a brown-gray broad board.

entities.name: wooden post beside the path
entities.identification: A brown-gray vertical columnar object to the image-left of the dark-handled, broad, flat tool, with its upper part outside the frame.
